x.author: stopbanningmep
x.body:
Does the U.S.-Russia diesel agreement mean the U.S. government is sending money to Russia? No. Nothing in the announcements or the Treasury license says that. The U.S. is temporarily allowing commercial sales (not to the Russia Government) and imports of Russian diesel so more supply can hit the market. Buyers pay for the fuel. That’s how oil and diesel trades work.  

Zelensky calling it “additional money for the war” and accusing us of using his team as cover is just fake news accusations. Rus
